'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Jon Cates DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jon Cates]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' FDR's Revenge - Another New Deal
* '''Username:''' sigmavonjon
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
